selected_note: The selected package carries the nodes of SL-01..SL-05, SL-06 (the published place), SL-07, the places and parameters of the presence section and PR-01 and PR-03, each at the graph index package_node names, and its timed root lists every place; its model_selections row digest is the SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 bytes of the whole selected document (FR-322-AC-240), whose projection of Order, Timer, ClockRow and ClockMap is the only declaration source of every resolved_path row. SL-03 and SL-04 declare the fields b and o (a model has one field c); the timed root key changed with the declared order of its aggregates (FR-322-AC-260) and the package id with it; the parameter node i, no longer the slot term of any admitted vector (PR-02 was dropped), stays published because PR-05 and PR-06 use it as an Integer owner and the owner/slot type checks name it.

nested_collection.rule: FR-322-AC-241: a collection whose element is a collection is declared by a named FCD type definition of kind sequence (or map) whose items (or values) names the element type; the field names that definition as typeRef and its multiplicity gives the outermost level, and the rendered type is derived: Sequence<Sequence<ix://quire/native/Clock>>

model_join.expected: the object_type node is the same node (one key, recomputed from its owner and its empty body) with and without v; its declared members are exactly sku and v, with no presence member and no Option<Boolean>; the v place row joins field v by identity, declared presence optional and typeRef Clock rendered Option<ix://quire/native/Clock>

rule: FR-322-AC-148..FR-322-AC-150; a clock_place is one template node for each clock path; the slot selector is a reference to the type node of the selector domain (Integer for Sequence, Set, Bag and OrderedSet, the key type for Map); a concrete position or key exists only on an instantiated place and enters no node
node_key: sha256 over the RFC 8785 bytes of {version, node_tag, semantic_form, semantic_type: null (self-typed), declaration: null, recursion: null, body}

aggregate_order.rule: FR-322-AC-260: the six reference aggregates of a timed_model root (clock_places, resets, guards, invariants, urgencies, constraints) and the guards of a clock_place list their members in declared order, the strictly ascending order of the member node's order key: the minimum (source.identity, start, end) over every region of every source_map entry of the node, compared in that order. No digest enters the order. A member that is not above its predecessor refuses invalid_semantic_graph, with no cause, at that member.
aggregate_order.order_key: minimum (source.identity, start, end) over all regions of all source_map entries of the member node
